end.summary:
Aryan identified rays, segments, lines, and endpoints using examples and diagrams.
They named segments, lines, and rays correctly, including that ray AB starts at A.
They counted connecting segments for 4 points and 5 points as 6 and 10.
They mixed up a longer drawing with a different line; later stated that 3 cm and 10 cm drawings can represent the same line.
They did not complete the teach-back.
end.parentNote: Aryan practised telling points, line segments, lines, and rays apart by their endpoints and arrows. They used the torch example for a ray, explained ray AB versus ray BA correctly, and counted all joining segments by grouping them from each point. They first said a longer line was a different or bigger line, then corrected this later by explaining that 3 cm and 10 cm drawings can represent the same line. At home, ask them to draw one line, one segment, and one ray and label the endpoints and arrows.
